Most team wikis eventually devolve into a chaotic, unsearchable mess of nested pages.

BookStack solves this structural nightmare by keeping things simple. It organizes your knowledge base exactly like a real library: Books, Chapters, and Pages. 

Get a fast, open-source wiki with a WYSIWYG editor up and running on PikaPods for just $2.10/mo.

https://pikapods.com/pods?run=bookstack

#opensource #selfhosted
